$$

$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}- x_{1} + x_{2} - x_{3} &=2 \\ x_{1} - x_{2} &=0 \\ - x_{2} &=-3\end{aligned}\right.
$$

We will solve this system using Gaussian elimination. First, we write the augmented matrix for this system:

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}-1 & 1 & -1 & 2 \\ 1 & -1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -1 & 0 & -3\end{array}\right]
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}M&=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}-1 & 1 & -1 & 2 \\ 1 & -1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -1 & 0 & -3\end{array}\right] \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 1 & -2 \\ 1 & -1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -1 & 0 & -3\end{array}\right] && R_{1}:=(-1)R_{1} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 1 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & -1 & 2 \\ 0 & -1 & 0 & -3\end{array}\right] && R_{2}:=R_{2}+(-1)R_{1} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 1 & -2 \\ 0 & -1 & 0 & -3 \\ 0 & 0 & -1 & 2\end{array}\right] && R_{2}\leftrightarrow R_{3} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 1 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & -1 & 2\end{array}\right] && R_{2}:=(-1)R_{2} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 1 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & -2\end{array}\right] && R_{3}:=(-1)R_{3}\end{aligned}
$$

The system is now

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x_{1} - x_{2} + x_{3} &=-2 \\ x_{2} &=3 \\ x_{3} &=-2\end{aligned}\right.

$$
1x_2+(0)(-2)=3\quad\Rightarrow\quad x_2=3

$$

$$

$$

$$

$$

$$
samples.solution:
A basis must be linearly independent and span $U$. The decomposition gives the system
$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}2x_{1}-2x_{2} &=-4 \\ x_{1}-x_{2} &=-2\end{aligned}\right.
$$
Its augmented matrix is
$$
\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}2 & -2 & -4 \\ 1 & -1 & -2\end{array}\right]
$$
Apply $R_{1}\leftarrow \left(\frac{1}{2}\right)R_{1}$:
$$
\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}1 & -1 & -2 \\ 1 & -1 & -2\end{array}\right]
$$
Apply $R_{2}\leftarrow R_{2}-R_{1}$:
$$
\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}1 & -1 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{array}\right]
$$
The reduced matrix is
$$
\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}1 & -1 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{array}\right]
$$
Only $1$ coefficient columns contain pivots. Thus the proposed vectors are linearly dependent. There is no contradictory row, so the last vector is in their span and they do span $U$.
